description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' for centralized logging in an Android environment. It provides static methods to log messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT) and manages a linked list of LogNode objects to handle log message processing.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class that mimics Android's Log class, providing static methods for logging messages at various levels and managing a LogNode chain for log processing.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain to which logging outputs are directed.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the LogNode chain.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level with optional Throwable.
